patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Closely share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Bombora and Closely share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Closely's shape. Choose Closely only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label ” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Closely leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Closely share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Closely is LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label options for agencies..
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Closely-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Closely — Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record..

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Closely: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.; Plans are gated by LinkedIn sender seats and enrichment/AI credit bundles..

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Closely is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record. · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Closely's motion (LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and wh)
